component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.watermark.marker
component.documentation: Since 0.6.0, what marks a video a rights policy's watermark marks: the platform's own video tools, VideoToolsService.watermark, whose videoWatermarkWithPicture command line runs ffmpeg's overlay with a picture of the mark drawn in Java, sized by the platform's ffmpeg-info command line, ffprobe. A server without ffmpeg has the service, and it says it cannot run: a video the watermark marks is then refused, never served unmarked. Its own service, so that a test runtime without ffmpeg stands in for it.
